title: Discovery of Anti-Hypercholesterolemia Agents Targeting LXRalpha from Marine Microorganism-Derived Natural Products.
authors: Fang, Yuwei; She, Jianglian; Zhang, Xi; Gu, Tanwei; Xie, Danni; Luo, Xiaowei; Yi, Xiangxi; Gao, Chenghai; Liu, Yonghong; Zhang, Cuixian; Tang, Lan; Zhou, Xuefeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海洋微生物天然产物靶向LXRalpha的降胆固醇活性，核心是蛋白-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: A strategy integrating in silico molecular docking with LXRalpha and phenotypic assays was adopted to discover anti-hypercholesterolemia agents in a small library containing 205 marine microorganism-derived natural products, collected by our group in recent years. Two fumitremorgin derivatives, 12R,13S-dihydroxyfumitremorgin C (1) and tryprostatin A (3), were identified as potential LXRalpha agonists, by real-time qPCR and Western blot (WB) analysis, together with a surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay. The anti-hypercholesterolemic effects of 1 and 3, together with their mechanisms, were investigated in depth using different cell and mouse models, among which the study of LXRalpha is of crucial importance. Compound 1 or 3 exhibited the capacity to effectively reverse excessive lipid accumulation in a hepatic steatosis cell model and significantly reduce liver damage and blood cholesterol levels in high cholesterol diet (HCD)-fed wild-type mice, whereas those beneficial effects were completely nullified in HCD-fed LXRalpha-knockout mice. Furthermore, 1 and 3 outperformed common LXRalpha agonists by suppressing the expression of sterol regulatory element-binding protein 1 (SREBP1) in HCD-fed mice, mitigating lipotoxicity. Thus, this study highlights the discovery of two marine microorganism-derived anti-hypercholesterolemia agents targeting LXRalpha.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用整合in silico分子对接与LXRalpha及表型分析的方法，旨在从我们课题组近年来收集的包含205种海洋微生物来源天然产物的小型化合物库中，发现抗高胆固醇血症药物。通过实时定量PCR（qPCR）和Western blot（WB）分析，结合表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验，鉴定出两种fumitremorgin衍生物，即12R,13S-dihydroxyfumitremorgin C（1）和tryprostatin A（3），为潜在的LXRalpha激动剂。利用不同的细胞和小鼠模型，深入研究了化合物1和3的抗高胆固醇血症效应及其作用机制，其中对LXRalpha的研究至关重要。化合物1或3展现出在肝脂肪变性细胞模型中有效逆转过量脂质积累的能力，并能显著降低高胆固醇饮食（HCD）喂养的野生型小鼠的肝损伤和血液胆固醇水平，然而，在HCD喂养的LXRalpha敲除小鼠中，这些有益效应完全消失。此外，与常见的LXRalpha激动剂相比，化合物1和3在HCD喂养的小鼠中通过抑制固醇调节元件结合蛋白1（SREBP1）的表达，减轻了脂毒性。因此，本研究突出了两种靶向LXRalpha的海洋微生物来源抗高胆固醇血症药物的发现。
